meta.name: customer-journey-map
meta.description: Create a customer journey map across stages, touchpoints, actions, emotions, and metrics. Use when diagnosing a broken experience or aligning a team on the full customer flow.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 绘制客户旅程地图，分析各阶段接触点与情绪。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要诊断用户体验痛点或对齐团队对客户流程的理解。
copy.tagline_en: Map customer journeys to analyze touchpoints, emotions, and metrics across stages.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to diagnose broken experiences or align your team on the full customer flow.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会引导你分阶段填写顾客旅程地图，包括每个阶段的客户行动、接触点、情绪、KPI、业务目标与涉及团队，最终生成一张完整表格。
howto.when: 当你描述一个客户体验问题（如诊断糟糕体验、对齐团队）时触发，或主动说出“创建客户旅程地图”时启动。

say.text: 帮我映射B2B SaaS新用户从注册到首次体验的旅程。
say.note: Claude会按 Awareness 等5个阶段引导填写。

say.text: 为我校友会的获客阶段创建一个旅程地图。
say.note: Claude会提示你定义人物画像并逐阶段填写。

howto.what_en: Guides you to fill in a customer journey map across stages (Awareness to Loyalty), documenting actions, touchpoints, emotions, KPIs, business goals, and teams for each stage. Outputs a comprehensive table.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you describe a customer experience issue (e.g., diagnosing a broken experience) or when you say 'create a customer journey map'.

say_en.text: Map the B2B SaaS onboarding journey from signup to first value.
Create a journey map for the acquisition stage of my alumni association.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for persona and fill stage details.
